about: Traits (Decision 64, rated; Decision 128): each id, what it does, its tags - which say where it may sit - and optionally 'only', narrowing that further. An item's own traits must be allowed on the item; what it 'grants' its carrier must be allowed on a unit.

traits.description: Plays dead more readily, and is harder to see through doing it; a leader's helps its formation's downed (Decision 127).
Hard to fool: sees through foes playing dead (Decision 127).
Captures downed foes rather than finishing them (Decision 121).
A routing unit with it never surrenders (Decision 121).
A leader's: lets one downed foe go home per level, a morale blow to its side (Decision 121).
Its formation retreats at a march rather than a run, if its leader or every unit has it (Decision 126).
Its formation pursues at a march rather than a run, if its leader or every unit has it (Decision 126).
Shrugs off its first N wounds (Decision 126).
Its regeneration keeps running while it is downed (Decision 121).
Carries more before it can't move: a higher load limit per level (Decision 120).
Digs through ground of dig_difficulty up to its level (Decision 64).
Climbs ground of climb_difficulty up to its level (Decision 64).
Swims faster: water at least its height deep at the swim pace plus a share a level (spec 30 round 3).
Can't swim at any load - the opposite of the norm, a cart (spec 30 round 3).
Sees in the dark (Decision 83).
A weapon's: damages structures (Decision 47).
A weapon's: a foe it downs takes N wounds more (Decision 126).
How hard it is to dig: a burrower of at least this level gets through (Decision 64).
How hard it is to climb: a climber of at least this level gets up (Decision 64).
It is a liquid, flowing at this rate (Decision 64).
It falls and settles (Decision 64).
It lights its surroundings at this level (Decision 64).
